1: For the Master. The first attack of the sons of light against the company of the sons of darkness, against the army of Belial: against the troops of Edom, Moab, the sons of Ammon, and the array of the dwellers in Philistia, and against the troops of the Kittim of Asshur and Egypt.

And there shall be a time of salvation for the people of God, and a period of dominion for all the men of His lot, and double recompense for the company of Satan, for they spoke against the chosen of God and took counsel against His saints.
2: [1QM 1:9-15 — The lot of the sons of light]
The sons of light and the lot of darkness shall battle together for God's might; against all the army of Belial there shall be a shouting for destruction for all the company of the gods of war.
And the sons of Zadok, the priests, and the men of the Community who hold firm to the covenant shall come forth and decree their sentence on the sons of darkness.
For this is the day appointed by Him from ancient times for the war of destruction of the sons of darkness.
3: And Thou, O God, art terrible in the glory of Thy majesty, and the congregation of Thy holy ones is among us for everlasting help.
We shall despise kings, we shall mock and scorn the mighty; for our Lord is holy, and the King of Glory is with us, together with the holy ones.
Mighty men and a host of angels are with our steps; the valiant of the army is with our commission. The order of our battles is the power of God.
